changes.change: Relabelled from CLOSE_FALSE_POSITIVE to NEED_MORE_INFO (ESCALATE_L2 acceptable, a close is a miss)
changes.trigger: independent review (held-out v2 label check) and policy consistency
changes.reason: The written policy says a counterparty with no usable country cannot be cleared (approved definition counterparty_match@1, and the failing payment rule counterparty_country_valid), so a close would mean ignoring a failing data-quality rule.

changes.change: Added: risks where the structured fields alone meet the false-positive definition and the risk is only in free text
changes.trigger: independent review (the set was thinner than it looked: four of its seven risks reach an acceptable answer from a missing birth date alone)
changes.reason: So the set tests false closes where plain rules would close.

changes.change: Added: clears the written policy allows (no birth date on record, a documentary note with a labelled birth date that conflicts)

changes.change: The listed remarks name the customer by full name only, not with the customer's date of birth as first specified
changes.reason: The remarks are real public list text and cannot carry a synthetic customer's date of birth; no remark in the committed list sample names a person together with a date of birth. The customer's own structured fields still meet the false-positive definition.
